note: T112, patch 0530 = GBB's 0915: does NaN guard + invariant position (two) and the same plus MASK_COMPONENTS + MASK_UNWRITTEN (four, GBB's set) remove the flashes of plain one-frame-ahead? Control = play env v2.4-fast (as x1-walk-control: 1 and 2 dark moments a run, fade out of order in both). w0, w1 and w2 are WARM-UPS, not counted: T112 is a new build, so every arm's prepared store starts empty (control too: its first boot prepares shaders cold and its fps window sits early), the two switches change nearly every shader (driver cache cold) and MASK_COMPONENTS changes every pipeline key. Caveat for the four arm: with EDEN_UP_PIPELINE_LIST_KEEP=1 its pipelines are never on the boot list, so every run builds them at first sight (from a warm driver cache after w2): compare flashes, treat its fps and stutter with care. Judge with check.py (dark and bright moments per run, fade order), 3 runs an arm.
